lead: Hema Malini is an Indian film actor, born on 16 October 1948 in Ammankudi.
As of 2026, she is 77 years old, and her birth date places her under the Libra sign.
She is associated with work such as Dream Girl, Seeta Aur Geeta and Sholay and has held the office of Member of the 16th Lok Sabha and member of Rajya Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Hema Malini: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Hema Malini — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists film actor, film director, film producer, dancer, television actor and politician as her occupations.
Among the credits most often linked to Hema are Dream Girl, Seeta Aur Geeta, Sholay, Satte Pe Satta, Dil Aashna Hai, Baghban and Sapno Ka Saudagar.
She has held the following offices: Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–present), member of Rajya Sabha (2003–2009) and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha. She is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
